# node-opcua
> The leading open-source OPC UA stack for Node.js / TypeScript. Client, server,
> and pub/sub SDK, production-grade since 2014. Maintained by Sterfive.

## Docs
- API reference: https://node-opcua.github.io/api_doc/
- Getting started: https://github.com/node-opcua/node-opcua

- Node-OPCUA goes TypeScript: https://node-opcua.github.io/info/2019/01/15/node-opcua-goes-typescript.html
- PubSub episode 1: https://node-opcua.github.io/concepts/2022/02/16/node-opcua-pubsub-episode1.html
- OPC UA Modeling vs tag naming: https://node-opcua.github.io/news/2024/03/19/OPC-UA-Model-vs-tag-naming-convention.html
- Boosting OPC UA client performance: https://node-opcua.github.io/2025/02/12/boosting-opcua-client-performance.html
